description: Size and external-origin budget for the self-contained dist/index.html.

externalOrigins.note: Conservative scan of every absolute http(s) URL in the built page. Any origin not listed here fails the check, even if the URL is only a comment, namespace or CSP source. The CDN and font origins were removed in v1.6.2 (everything is vendored now); openxmlformats is a namespace string inside the XLSX export, not a fetch.
